title: Unknown-age stands get $0 carbon but full stumpage revenue — the protect-vs-log comparison is structurally tilted toward logging for every stand without PROJ_AGE_1
evidence: src/lib/carbon/calculator.ts:116-118 (effectiveAge = max(0, age ?? 0) → C(0) = 0 for unknown) vs :249 (stats.unknownHa * TIMBER_VOLUME['unknown'] * rate) and src/lib/carbon/markets.ts:62 (unknown: 200 m³/ha)
detail: For a feature with no PROJ_AGE_1 and no harvest date, classifyAge returns 'unknown', carbonPerHa evaluates to C_max*(1-e^0) = 0, so it contributes zero tonnes and zero carbon-market dollars — but calculateFinancialValue credits it 200 m³/ha × $24 = $4,800/ha of 'Logging revenue' and $2,300/ha/yr ecosystem services. The 'unknown' bar is shown in the breakdown, so a selection with material unknown area renders a 'Value If Protected vs. Revenue If Logged' chart where the logging side is inflated by area the carbon side treated as bare ground. That is a number the data cannot support in both directions (CHARTER done-3): if we don't know the age we know neither the carbon nor the timber. Failing input: one polygon, SPECIES_CD_1='HW', no PROJ_AGE_1, no HARVEST_DATE, 100 ha → panel shows 0 tonnes CO2, $0 BC Compliance, $480,000 logging revenue. Consistent fix options for Lee: (a) exclude unknownHa from stumpage (TIMBER_VOLUME.unknown = 0), or (b) give unknown stands the DEFAULT-species mid-age carbon they implicitly get in the timber table. Either way METHODOLOGY.md must state the rule (see R3-02). The three unit tests in carbon-calculator.test.ts pin unknown → 0 carbon but nothing pins the stumpage side.
bucket_reason: public number contradicts itself; needs Lee's rule choice, one-line code change

detail: MapErrorBoundary.buildMailtoHref, the page.tsx <a href>, and the page.tsx onClick each inline 'mailto:opencanopymap@gmail.com' and the 'Bug Report — OpenCanopy' subject (Footer.tsx:60 has a fourth bare mailto). Changing the address means four edits. A shared buildBugReportMailto(body, subjectSuffix) in lib/ would fix it, but the three bodies genuinely differ (crash message vs map state vs none) and none of it is under test. Decline for now: payoff is one string constant, and the refactor would touch page.tsx, the largest, least-tested file in the repo. [sub-reader finding]
bucket_reason: tempting but payoff (one address constant) < the cost of a page.tsx edit with no test net

title: LayerPanel CATEGORIES lists accountability/water/species, which cannot render under the PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS gate
evidence: src/components/panels/LayerPanel.tsx:39-58 and :312-315; src/lib/layers/registry.ts:882-905
detail: LayerPanel builds sections from LAYER_REGISTRY_AVAILABLE, which is filtered to 7 public ids (forest-age, old-growth-250, cutblocks, parks, fire-history, tap-priority, satellite). Three of seven CategoryConfig entries always get layers.length===0 and return null (LayerPanel.tsx:222). Harmless at runtime and load-bearing for re-widening the public surface (the registry keeps the hidden layers on purpose: 'stay in LAYER_REGISTRY for audit tests'). Do not remove; note only so nobody 'cleans up' the CategorySection null-return, which is what keeps this correct. [sub-reader finding]
bucket_reason: unreachable by design, kept for the planned re-expansion; removal buys nothing

summary: Shape: the story/route/panel/carbon slice is structurally sound — no story↔registry merge (one type/data import crosses from lib/timeline into lib/story, R3-05), the dolly is genuinely gone from main (only inert camera/pitch generality remains, R3-11), page.tsx is long but only one of its eight responsibilities (the carbon-calc orchestration) is business logic in the wrong place (R3-07). The drift is in what the public is TOLD, not in what the code does: four public-facing statements the shipped data or repo cannot back — the '8 million hectares' hero figure vs the repo's own 7.06M scrub total (R3-08, needs pipeline-side reconciliation), unknown-age stands earning full stumpage but zero carbon (R3-03), a PDF pointer to a methodology page that does not exist (R3-04), and a privacy page claiming the analytics tracker's source is in this repo when it loads from ssc-ops.netlify.app (R3-12). Single most important item: R3-08, because it is the landing page's headline number and CHARTER done-3 is explicit about it. Second: the CHARTER's 'calculator must match METHODOLOGY.md exactly' has no enforcement — constants DO match today (verified row by row), but METHODOLOGY.md omits the financial model, the clamp, and the presentation rules, and no test pins any of it (R3-02/R3-10); the 08-05 negative-age fix has no regression test. Verified clean: every carbon constant, formula, threshold and precedence vs METHODOLOGY.md; the proxy's 7-day TTL claim; the reduced-motion crash fix still absent from globals.css with correct e2e selectors (but the e2e never runs in CI, R3-09); the CTA hash round-trip; the fire chapter's claim (9.25M ha burned 2017-2025 > all logging on record); no stale tap-deferrals/conservation-priority/Threats/Protection ids anywhere in ui/panels/landing; no component hard-codes a registry layer id; the restore recipe for the docked dolly is already broken independent of this refresh (R3-01). Real guards confirmed (would go red): scrollytelling-raf (with control chapters), carbon-presentation, clip, cta-hash, prefetch-binary (exact z-set), binary-reveal-opacity, story-consistency (range cross-checks), SearchBar (15), LayerPanel (5), CalculatorPanel (16), pdf-generator (4), contrast-audit, scrub, tile-manifest, forest-base-dims, source-registration. Hollow or mislocated: visibility.ts idle-deferral (R3-14), a duplicated describe block (R3-15), a data pin masquerading as an a11y guard (R3-18), and carbon-calculator's >0-only assertions (R3-10). Buckets: 11 A, 3 B, 3 C, 4 D.
